title: Chicken Pot Pie Tater Tot Casserole
description: A comforting casserole combining chicken, vegetables, and tater tots, topped with optional cheese and parsley.
steps: Add butter to a hot pan and sauté diced onions until tender and slightly colored.
Stir in flour, then add salt, black pepper, milk, chicken broth, and garlic powder.
Cook until the mixture becomes smooth and thick.
Add shredded chicken and mixed vegetables, stir until heated through.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 baking dish.
Top with a bag of tater tots.
Optional: sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
Bake at 425°F for about 30 minutes until golden.
